title: Prepare for a conversation
body:
Before starting a conversation, decide what you want to ask and which person or team can help. Read the destination and the people who can see the conversation before sending.

Use personal learning notes for reminders about using the app. Keep names, case details, documents and evidence out of those notes. Case evidence belongs in the authorized case workflow while connected.

Sending messages requires a connection. A note saved on this phone is not a sent message and is not shared with your chapter. Check the conversation after an interrupted send before sending again.
